name: Identity family selected on a Principal-bearing statement -> UNSUPPORTED_PRINCIPAL
note: IAM-1001 suite-3 test 67. An identity policy attaches to a principal and never CONTAINS a Principal element. With Identity explicitly selected, the engine must block with UNSUPPORTED_PRINCIPAL naming the exact JSON path, and must NOT drop the Principal and analyze the remainder (s3:GetObject on a public bucket) as an identity grant.
